verdict.rationale: A probe confirms NVIDIA serves a root llms.txt at docs.nvidia.com that collects llms.txt files "for AI user agents". Related stack docs (CUDA, NeMo, NIM, JAX Toolbox) each have their own llms.txt that an agent can follow. However, the DGX B200 user guide has no markdown variant (the .md probe returned 404), and no B200-specific llms.txt entry is evidenced, so agent-oriented coverage of the product's own docs is unproven. Missing for 10: a B200/DGX-specific llms.txt or markdown docs, evidence that the B200 user guide is listed in the llms.txt index, and hands-on corroboration of agents using it.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
